version_scope: Original setup.py fallback for the verified Git archive without a tag; not a published release number.

numpy.source_archive_difference: doc/make.bat differs from the Git blob; Windows documentation helper, not compiled or executed. All 2111 other root-tree source files match.

accepted_scope: Synthetic integer tokens only; original in-memory index/scoring/retrieval compared with scalar BM25S Lucene formula. Output contains counts, no documents, tokens, indices or raw scores.
